h: Tinubu video taking aim at Atiku and Obi trends: 'You will not regret it'
p: A video of President Tinubu urging voters to back him while taking aim at Atiku Abubakar and Peter Obi is trending online. It comes from the build-up to his campaign flag-off in Kaduna. Opposition supporters and APC loyalists are trading comments under the clip.
more: Atiku earlier replied to Tinubu's hunger remarks, calling him delusional.
The clip has been shared widely on X and Facebook.
